high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Jerry Olsen, who lives in California. The post is titled "Is there someone who got real life superpowers after an accident?" and was posted on June 19. The text describes a tragic incident that occurred in 1881 involving a five-year-old boy from Nyesville, Indiana. The boy's right hand was caught in a chopping machine used to separate grain from stalks and husks. The blades of the machine severed his index finger, leaving it as a stump.
